description: This file contains SQL scripts for creating and configuring XML database schemas, registering schemas, renaming tables, uploading files, and managing directory permissions related to an order entry system. It includes schema registration, resource creation, execution of stored procedures, and file system interactions.

methods.name: DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.registerSchema
methods.description: Registers an XML schema with the database using a given URI, schema content, and options.

methods.name: coe_utilities.renameCollectionTable
methods.description: Renames a collection table within the XML data structure to improve clarity or organization.

methods.name: coe_utilities.uploadFiles
methods.description: Uploads files from a specified directory into the XML database repository.
